neighbours.label: shimmering decorative surfaces: the word pieces of holographic, sequined, iridescent (and similar sparkly finishes)
fire: She glued holographic stickers onto the cover of her notebook.
The singer wore a sequined jacket that caught every stage light.
We painted the shells with iridescent varnish for the craft fair.
The card came with a hologram seal so it could not be copied.
Her nails were done in a glittery holographic polish.
The curtain was covered in sequins that flashed in the breeze.
Beetles with iridescent wings were pinned in the museum case.
The children decorated the box with sparkly holographic decals.
quiet: She glued paper stickers onto the cover of her notebook.
The singer wore a leather jacket that suited every stage light.
We painted the shells with clear varnish for the craft fair.
The card came with a printed seal so it could be posted.
Her nails were done in a pale matte polish.
The curtain was covered in stripes that moved in the breeze.
Beetles with brown wings were pinned in the museum case.
The children decorated the box with colorful vinyl decals.
